Manager- Government Partnerships( Jammu and Kashmir)

Help us make learning accessible to everyone.

Associate - Government Partnerships (JnK)

Job Location: Jammu and Kashmir
Experience: 3-5 Years
Job Type: Full-time

About Filo

Imagine a world where every student had a personal teacher available to them in seconds, whenever they needed, 24x7

Filo is the world's only online instant live tutoring platform built to bring the power of one-to-one high-frequency learning to students from all backgrounds. With Filo, a student is never stuck while studying and can connect to a teacher for a live one-to-one video session within 60 seconds at a click of a button, 24x7. More than 5 million students across 25 countries have leveraged Filo in their day to day learning. Having won 5 National Awards from the government of India, Filo is one of the most leading education products in the public education sector.

Filo takes care of any gaps in a student's understanding throughout the year, making their daily learning process extremely effective. Which is reflected in their academic performance in a short period of time. Since students are the ones setting up the agenda for these instant-classes, it works as per every student's pace and understanding. Teachers are instantly matched by Filo's patented algorithms from 60,000 Filo experts based on the student's profile and needs.

With Filo, students can:

  • Connect to a live teacher over a one-to-one video call, in under 60 seconds, 24x7 - yes even at 4 a.m. on Sunday
  • Unblock their learning whenever they are stuck while self-studying at home
  • Completely remove the problem of ‘shyness’ among students
  • Inculcate a habit of asking questions in a personal one-to-one setup
  • Improve performance by learning what they need at their pace
  • Build confidence among students for peer conversations

Job Summary

We are looking for dynamic and results-driven individuals for Manager/Associate-Government Partnerships to lead our efforts in identifying and expanding business opportunities. The ideal candidate will possess strong skills in market research, relationship building, and strategic planning, especially in engaging with government bodies and public sector organizations. This role is pivotal in driving the company’s growth and achieving long-term partnerships with both government and private stakeholders.

What you'll do

  • Business Opportunity Identification:
    • Conduct comprehensive market research to identify emerging business opportunities and build strong pipelines in target markets.
    • Assess and prioritize potential areas for expansion based on market trends and company goals.
  • Relationship Building:
    • Establish and foster relationships with government bodies and public sector organizations to explore potential collaborations, partnerships, and contracts.
    • Build and maintain strong relationships with current and prospective stakeholders to drive long-term business partnerships.
  • Strategic Planning:
    • Develop and implement strategic business plans and sales strategies aligned with company objectives to meet growth targets.
    • Collaborate closely with internal teams to understand business needs and ensure alignment with organizational goals.
  • Proposal and Presentation Development:
    • Prepare, present, and follow through on detailed proposals, reports, and presentations to senior management and key stakeholders.
    • Utilize data-driven insights to support proposals and ensure effective stakeholder engagement.
  • Stakeholder Management:
    • Manage relationships with a diverse range of stakeholders, ensuring timely communication and coordination.
    • Facilitate strong connections with government or private sector partners to support business objectives.
  • Develop the revenue model and strategy: Define the value proposition of Filo’s offerings and design sustainable revenue models. Prepare annual/monthly sales plans, budgets and pricing strategies.

What we're looking for

  • Experience with Government Partnerships with government agencies - state, district or national level is required
  • Graduates from one of the public policy fellowships in India - Gandhi Fellowship, Public Policy in Action(PPIA), Piramal Foundation, Transform Rural India (TRI) organization, Teach for India organization (TFI) etc. is a plus
  • Strong planning and project management skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention-to-details.
  • Ability to communicate and interact effectively with key stakeholders at all levels within and outside the organisation.
  • Good organisational and time management skills to help keep projects on track.
